# Figmafolio

> Figmafolio puts a Figma prototype online as a website. Paste a Figma prototype link and get a live site you can share. It is free for 7 days, then from $3 a month. Prices vary a little by country.

## Questions people ask, and the short answer

**How do I turn a Figma prototype into a website?**
Paste the prototype link into Figmafolio. It gives you a live site that shows your prototype as it is, so the interactions and transitions are Figma's own. Changes you make in Figma show on the site without publishing again.

**Is Figmafolio free?**
Free for 7 days, then from $3 a month. After the 7 days a site goes offline until the owner chooses a plan.

**Can I use my own domain?**
Yes, on the Solo and Pro plans.

**Can I password protect a site?**
Yes, on the Basic, Solo and Pro plans. The password protects the Figmafolio site, not the Figma prototype behind it.

**Can I have one link for desktop and mobile?**
Yes. Add a desktop prototype and a mobile prototype to one site. The site shows one by screen size, and you choose the breakpoint.

**Does Figmafolio show who visits my site?**
Yes, on the Solo and Pro plans: visitors, visits, pageviews, bounce rate, visit duration, and lists of sources, countries, devices, browsers and operating systems.

**How does it compare with Figma Sites?**
See the comparison page. Figma Sites builds real web pages; Figmafolio publishes a prototype as it is.

## What Figmafolio does not do
It does not build real web pages, export code, or make a sitemap or RSS feed for your site. It does not promise search rankings. User testing moved to Aero.
